connect-grid.looks: A heading and intro above a grid of cards: an icon, a title, a short description, then up to four contact lines (a small label above the contact itself, as a link).
connect-grid.use: Ways to reach NCMEC or get help: phone numbers, email addresses, forms.

fields.contactMethod1Link: tel:, mailto: or a page, e.g. tel:18008435678.
